scope: Read-only visual verification of closed-eye spacing changes; no Rive or App edits.
sequence: Each expression holds for 180 frames / 3 seconds, followed by 180 frames at expression 0.

observations.result: Smile arches, laughing chevrons, and content U curves remain distinct. Wider spacing did not flatten their shapes excessively; stroke height and mouth balance remain coherent.
Horizontal eyes are visibly wider and less crowded. Side margins remain adequate; helpless slant and lowered sleepy posture remain distinguishable.
Half-closed eyes form broad shallow lids without excessive horizontal distortion. Existing small mouth and vertical spacing remain readable.
Viewed return frame 1305 restores the original capsule-eye appearance without a residual mouth or sleep mark.

Viewed native PNG samples preserve eye separation and distinguish smile, laugh, content, flat, half-closed, slanted, and lowered variants in both sampled themes. Sleep Z is intentionally faint during this sampled entry phase.

conclusion: No further spacing adjustment indicated by these viewed samples.
boundaries: All six sequences were genuinely advanced frame-by-frame and rendered through Rive Apple Runtime 6.25.1 Metal to 8640 GPU-completed frames and full MOVs.
Manual visual review was of the 18 listed PNGs, not uninterrupted human viewing of every movie frame. Unlisted intermediate-frame appearance is not claimed as individually inspected.
State-change records come from a separate official legacy inspection replay, not the rendered instance; random idle branches may differ.
48/80pt evidence uses native 3x pixel dimensions. Physical-device display, wall-clock smoothness, energy use, and App integration were not tested.
size-check.html was generated using actual 48/80 CSS dimensions but was not opened and visually checked in a browser.
Mixed action combinations and legacy writing/sweat verification are handled separately by the root agent and excluded from these six-run totals.
